steps.name: temperature demo boots with the Sht31 over I2C

assert.substring: Set the temperature above 25 degrees to trigger the warning LED

steps.name: the warning LED stays off while the sensor reports 20.50 C
raise the simulated sensor above 25 degrees on the SHT31 component
give the demo's 500ms loop a cycle to act on the new reading
the demo's threshold turns the warning LED on for the hotter reading
